stem: What happens next in this passage after “Students followed the data over a year.”?
options: They learned that new environmental solutions should be watched after installation, not praised once and forgotten.
A canal that once carried goods through the city was nearly forgotten after roads and trucks became common.
Students studying the project learned that environmental damage can happen gradually and repair can take even longer.
Students visiting the farm learned that new tools can change old work without making old knowledge useless.
